title: REQ · Scene view with clickable hotspots, asset path map and action menu
summary: Clickable object hotspots open an action menu that runs runtime actions
description: Context: game/src/engine/scene.ts exposes getSceneView and performAction; bedroom.yaml defines bed, bookshelf, desk, old-computer, window, door. Desired behavior: SceneView renders pixel-art placeholder background and a hotspot button per object using a replaceable asset path map; clicking opens ActionMenu with the object's available actions. Expected result: clicking an object and an action updates state. Why: point-and-click gameplay.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bedroom scene, When rendered, Then a button named for each object is shown
Given a hotspot click, When ActionMenu opens, Then it lists the object's action labels
Given an action click, When pressed, Then onAction is called with objectId and actionId
Given assets.ts, When a path is changed, Then SceneView uses the new path

out_of_scope: Contribution form and 'Suggest What Happens Next' flow
preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: Acceptance criteria demonstrated by unit tests
